text: {"lessons":["My account fell about 4% early on, but later moves were smaller and mixed; short-term losses are uncomfortable, yet they alone don't tell me what prices will do next.","Since past price changes don't predict future changes, I shouldn't trade just to react to recent performance; any trade should have a clear reason and fit my plan.","I made no trades and remained invested, so I should keep reviewing my risk and cash needs periodically without letting loss aversion or infrequent check-ins drive impulsive decisions."]}
